title: The 2000s & 2010s Pop Quiz
subtitle: Fifteen questions. Twenty seconds each. Fastest fingers win.
notes: Written 3 September 2026 for a short two-quiz night. Deliberately shares no answer with the other 2000s packs on the shelf, so it can follow them at the same venue. READ EVERY QUESTION IN THE EDITOR BEFORE THE GIG — written in one pass without the generator's second checking call.

rounds.title: Round One — 2000s & 2010s Pop
rounds.blurb: 15 questions on the pop of 2000 to 2010

questions.prompt: Which Glasgow band had a 2004 hit with "Take Me Out"?
questions.answerNote: The song changes tempo about a minute in, which is why it still fills a dancefloor.

questions.prompt: Which 2006 Arctic Monkeys album was the fastest-selling debut in UK chart history?
options: Whatever People Say I Am, That's What I'm Not
questions.answerNote: It shifted well over 300,000 copies in its first week on sale.

questions.prompt: Which X Factor winner released "Bleeding Love" in 2007?
questions.answerNote: Ryan Tedder of OneRepublic co-wrote it.

questions.prompt: "Hips Don't Lie" gave which Colombian singer a UK number one in 2006?
Which single, released in 2008, was Lady Gaga's debut?
questions.answerNote: It features Colby O'Donis and came off her album The Fame.

questions.prompt: Which London rapper topped the UK chart in 2010 with "Pass Out"?
questions.answerNote: It took two Brit Awards for him the following year.

questions.prompt: Which band released "Year 3000" and "Crashed the Wedding" before splitting in 2005?
questions.answerNote: Two of them reunited with McFly years later as McBusted.

questions.prompt: Which producer made "Maneater" with Nelly Furtado and "SexyBack" in the same year?
questions.answerNote: 2006 was the year he seemed to be on every record in the chart.

questions.prompt: Which Glasgow band's "Chelsea Dagger" became a terrace anthem?
questions.answerNote: It is named after the singer's wife, who performed under that name.

questions.prompt: Which 2010 Katy Perry single features Snoop Dogg?
questions.answerNote: It was the lead single from her album Teenage Dream.

questions.prompt: Which Coldplay album came between "Parachutes" and "X&Y"?
options: A Rush of Blood to the Head
questions.answerNote: It gave them both "The Scientist" and "Clocks".

questions.prompt: "Hallelujah" was the 2008 Christmas number one for which X Factor winner?
questions.answerNote: Jeff Buckley's version of the same song reached number two that week.

questions.prompt: Which Estelle single featuring Kanye West topped the UK chart in 2008?
questions.answerNote: It won a Grammy for Best Rap/Sung Collaboration the following year.

questions.prompt: Which Welsh singer released the 2008 album "Rockferry"?
questions.answerNote: Its single "Mercy" reached number one in the UK.

questions.prompt: "Tik Tok" was a 2010 UK number one for which American singer?
questions.answerNote: She styled her name with a dollar sign at the time.
